checklist.note: No model-directed steering text; SKILL.md is plain usage/contract prose.
Script only calls local sf CLI and parses its JSON output to stdout; nothing sent elsewhere.
No embedded keys/tokens/credentials; org auth relies on pre-existing sf CLI session via --org alias.
Only sf project deploy start / sf apex run test are run; no rm, force-push, dd, or chmod.
Inline python3 parsing blocks are plain readable JSON-handling code, not encoded payloads.
No curl/wget/network calls beyond the sf CLI's own org communication, which is the stated purpose.
No reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, or keychain; relies on sf CLI's own auth store implicitly, not accessed directly.
No sudo, setuid, or persistence (cron/profile/launch agent) edits present.
